metadata.title: Koldil bhaji
metadata.description:
Assamese-Style Banana Flower Stir Fry 

Dive into the rich flavors of Assam with this traditional banana flower stir fry! A perfect blend of earthy spices and the unique texture of banana flower makes this dish a wholesome and delicious treat. It's not just tasty, but also packed with nutrients. 

Swipe to see how you can recreate this authentic recipe at home! 🍲✨
